caption: The video captures a slow-motion, side-on view of a dark teal water surface against a plain white background, with a bright cyan region submerged below the surface line. A single wave crest rises near the center, its rounded top protrusion already deforming. As the clip proceeds, the protrusion elongates and curls forward and downward, thickening into a hook-like lip that encloses a small air cavity beneath it. The crest body reshapes continuously while staying roughly centered, and the surface line to its left undulates and lowers slightly. Several dark air bubbles remain suspended in the cyan water below, one isolated on the left and a cluster near the center-bottom, drifting slowly rightward relative to the crest. The deformation continues progressing through the final frame.
relations: The rounded top protrusion elongates and curls forward-downward, thickening into a hook-like lip enclosing a small air cavity.
The crest body reshapes continuously while staying roughly centered above the cyan submerged region.
The surface line left of the crest undulates and lowers slightly as the crest deforms.
Suspended dark bubbles in the cyan water drift slowly rightward relative to the crest.
